timing.source: declared demonstration tempo; not measured from source photographs

correction.foot_span_source: One fixed median source stance on the rigid footplate; source depth remains inferred.
correction.foot_orientation: rest plantar soles aligned to the rigid footplate normal
correction.source: reference-inferred rail and source lower knee bend; declared soft extension and eased source phase timing; not calibrated

body_stabilization.method: One fixed supported body and direct leg-only rail IK; no per-frame torso/head search.

sled_motion.method: Actual all-frame joint coordinates; fixed supported torso and hands, source-phase leg range.

pelvis_seat_fit.method: One fixed finite posterior pelvis pad fitted to actual all-frame skin contact.

backrest.source: fixed pad aligned to the measured torso; not a calibrated machine angle
